rules: Implement only the assigned task and preserve project product/architecture constraints.
Preserve unrelated changes, secrets, user data, paused work and owner-only hardware/release gates.
Use the existing project task authority; no new queue, migration or automatic activation.
Return scoped code/tests only. The host applies, checks and handles local Git and task state.
Never weaken checks or claim unperformed validation. Request missing context rather than inventing facts.
Keep existing native Android shell and project/module boundaries; do not broaden a reference UI task.
